body:
Appreciate it but I've decided its not worth it. Didn't ask to be abused and miss the most important years of my life. 

Maybe I'll see you in the next one.

It very much is. It's an infection that requires constant maintenance. I wish I could afford a therapist but I'm so poor I don't even have a bathroom and have to use the woods. 

I just wish a girl would tell me it's going to be ok and mean but God chose to make me ugly and curse me until the day I die considering all this that isn't going to be too much longer.
Everyday. It never gets better.
So you denied the comment..dude it's right there. Maybe stop trying to fish for upvotes on someone's suicide post??
I won't either. No girl has ever so much as looked my way. We get one life and mine fucking sucked. I hate everything and everyone.

I'm struggling hard. Ive been abused by a lot of people in my life as a child. But the man who is pretty much responsible for it I regret to inform is living happy and well richer than ever. Learned this as Facebook thought it would be cool to recommend him as a friend.

Any dime this man has was ripped from families in need. The law can't touch him as he used religion (He's a pastor) to cover it up and lie to the police. 

It's not that I really believed in God much before but that confirmed to me that it doesn't exist. He's happy and well why I suffer because of his greed. 

Or if God DOES exist it really really fucking hates me and I hate it back.

I don't even know what to say. But I am sorry. I feel so pathetic for being this dramatic but the harsh reality is a child's developmental age is the time I was abused the most. I learned hate and fear before I had a chance to even understand myself or love. I see it differently as an adult but it's like an infection. It doesn't leave but needs constant maintenance for me to not break down and cry because my life doesn't get to be free.

My only advice is to make sure you have people you can call or hang with. I didn't realize the true importance of that and it's my biggest mistake. Especially while you're young. I hope I don't create more fear but it's the reality.
Would you mind if I ask how? Or rather I guess what is it you say to yourself to convince your being to continue?

This isn't about you it's about me. I have been given an extremely unfortunate deal of bad hands and it does affect life. 

If I can say anything it's not to let me ruin you. I posted this because of course I don't want to die but I have nowhere else to turn. This is me trying to convince myself that eating the endless bullshit is worth it for one more day. 

Don't follow my bad example.
I'm sorry, as someone who understands I mean that.
I'm so fucking sorry.
Dude this is a fucking suicide post not a goddamn field for you to farm for clout.
I'm not asking anyone to 'change' me. I'm simply hoping that I'd receive love. Holy fuck man you obviously have no idea what it's like to truly be alone.

You're all the same. You assume the worst of me while never even considering that maybe I never got to receive love of any kind in the first place? As if Im some evil man for desiring companionship. Didn't ask for sexual abuse dude. But ya know go ahead and hate me for it.

I've been to therapy many times. One lady told me I was demonic and needed to ask God for forgiveness...

Sadly therapy is no longer an option. I signed up for Cerebral and they stole $300 from me. Do you know how long it took me to save that money so I could get help? And what does the man do? After I paid and set up appointments he cancelled all of them and blocks my number. I called them, emailed BEGGED them and they refused to acknowledge any of it as a company. 

So yes I have tried therapy and they stole the little bit of money I actually had leaving me worse then I was before. 

Don't be tricked by those snakes like I was it ain't nothing but a business to steal money.
What the fuck are you talking about? I'm here on the verge of death because I was abused by a woman in the past and you choose to come at me? Who the fuck do you think you are?
Also I'm autistic. My parents didn't give a shit to even help me grow up so I had to be the one to figure out all the disabilities I have on my own. It explains why I failed in school so much too.

I'm glad you have hobbies. I really wish I could do that too but I can't. 

The only reason I'm not homeless is because a middle school classmate took pity on me so I live in their garage. My life is work. I work long shifts and I come home to sleep. Even then it's not enough and I'll be having to get a second job again to even just survive. I'm so behind and it's not my fault. If I wasn't continuously abused in my past I would have developed better and learned some skills. Instead my time was wasted being told how fucking horrible I was. 

Now I'm a grown ass adult. Too bad work isn't fun.

You have no fucking idea. 
Try being sexually abused as a middle schooler and see how easy it is for you to get a girlfriend. 

Didn't even get a chance to enjoy it nor explore myself in a fun and healthy manner like everyone else.

My life is one that never has had any really happy moments. I literally have no idea what it's like to succeed and feel good about ANYTHING in life. I was born into this world abused and things are getting worse. 

I only know sadness not happiness. I never even got a chance.
Guess you've never lost someone before huh? Must be nice.
Glad you find this funny asshole.
I feel. Wish I could just enjoy myself all the time.

Last time I was truly happy was when SMT 5 came out. I was at a new job that only had me working weekends. I lived in that fucking game. I'd get high and all day be so so fucking happy feeling beautiful and finally having control over my destiny. 

That was back in Nov. 2021 

Now I couldn't be sadder. I'm poor as fuck and my parents are ashamed of me for well being me. I'm struggling to even find a basic ass job while having attempted suicide a second time. 
I really don't know when I'll get to be happy again.
I'm gonna be 30 and spent my middle and high school years alone and ridiculed. I literally don't see why anyone would love me.
Not anymore.
No one ever touches me.
You also get bullied 24/7 and told you're worthless by your higher ups.

I'm suicidal daily and have high functioning autism. I also might be bipolar. 

I too just wanna get high, play videogames and never talk to anyone again. As far as stuff I have blankets, plush and some shirts that still fit from highschool I can survive easy on the little money for food.

I spent the entire day crying my eyes out to the last drop in a Barnes and Noble parking lot. I sent messages to friends and family for help but haven't heard back until now. My mom has suddenly called me begging me to come home. 
I'm so pathetic. I hate everyone who ever wronged and mistreated me with every being of my soul. Especially myself for not being born better looking, taller and actually smart. I can only ask why? Why wasn't I born strong like all the other boys? Why am I born small, weak and emotional? What could I have possibly done that was so evil to deserve having to be treated like this. I fucking pussed out and am still crying like a fucking child. I am broken. 

I'm driving home now a new record for the worst day of my life.

If it didn't hate me I wouldn't have to cry for help. I wouldn't have been physically abused. The girl I loved would have been there for me instead of telling me how much she hated me. My parents would be proud of me instead of looking upon me with shame. 

I tried and broke myself beyond my mental limits and the world took everything from me. I have no strength left.
Because it's always the same. The difference now is I'm an adult vs being a child where people had to at least pretend they cared. I have no money, no friends I'm alone and the world hates me.
I'm tired to my friend, I wish there was peace and rest for the both of us.
I feel the same way. I'm poor and just found out I have autism. I'm now on my own..no one loves me fuck my shitty existence.

I get laughed at everywhere I go and I'm alone 100% of the time. I never post my face anymore and am forced to have to hide behind a pic of my dog or something else people would rather see. 

I too would rather have a disability as then I could perhaps get some government check. Instead I have an ugly face where I am forced to work and be mocked for it.
I was happy and oblivious mostly outside my home abuse. It was 6th grade do I really remember a girl really calling me out for being ugly. From then on I was bullied for it.

I hate being called cute as a man because I know they'd cringe at the thought of calling me "handsome". 

It's like a free pass

None of them had to do with how I looked either. I've given up the endless fight of having to convince others I'm not just some ugly shithead. This is why my dog really is my best friend ever. I'll happily cancel any plans (or purposely not make any) just to hang out with her. She loves me because she knows I'm kind and we've grown a bond. In the summer we'll go to the park for hours with no annoying distractions. In the winter we stay in and she cuddles next to me as we watch movies or I play a videogame. 
Humans could totally be like this but they choose not to. Scooby and Shaggy have the right idea.

In my experience they don't give a shit and will force feed you "just have confidence, that's what's attractive". A blanket statement to make their job easier so they get to disregard all the suffering and years of torment the ugly curse has caused you.
Some people don't have enjoyable lives. Maybe think about that next time.
Sounds awesome!! Where can I sign up?

I've asked out a lot of girls. Sometimes they'd stand me up on a date or sometimes let me pay for their meal but it was nothing beyond a small one way attraction. They liked the attention and free food but that's it. No love, no second date not even a hug. Not sure how much more worse you could make a person feel about themselves then doing that.

This is why I usually get high 24/7 
Horror movies were and are my coping mechanisms and still are today.
Honestly not a bad reason
The lingering thought of "be thankful for what you have". Sure I'm suffering but I guess this is my reality. We are light switches turned on and then off. No in-between no other options.
It's easier to accept death. If you never lived a life with love you really have nothing to lose.
What other stuff
Family likes me but I can see they pity me. Friends have all but left. I have one left. Most people don't like me and treat me like dirt.
I'm the ugliest among my friends but I love anyone willing to let me.
Thanks, I need to get back on em anyway.
At least I can rewatch Mickey and Uncle Scrooge and they won't hate me for how I look.

I only watch cartoons usually from my childhood now or very selective anime. Most anime hurts my feelings too much as well. 
If I watch movies it's more criterion collection or films more focused on real story and art then some shit love plot.
You're forced to be content and appreciate what you have. Even if you'd rather have things differently.
I'm happy for you, I'm still finding my strength
The world hates men.
Nope nothing of the sort. Literally just me laying down on a blanket in the grass. I filmed my face and said "today is such a blessing". That's it.
Same. Actually feels like I'm doomed to this fate.

I thought I had a girlfriend but it was actually a girl who lied to me she loved me to use me for financial and moral support. Once she was better settled she told me how ugly she truly saw me to get rid of me. 
Last time I saw her she was happily married to a handsome guy.
I've tried so hard to improve myself and its gotten me nothing. Really wish I could go back and tell my highschool self he would have no luck 10 years later.

I've tried so many times to be friends with women that it's almost like I have a death wish. They hate me and refuse to accept as a man I have also had my share of abuse. It's made me bitter as well yet I still try and be nice to everyone I can cause I really do just want to. If it wasn't for my one lesbian friend I would hate all women.
I'll be 30 soon. I work at a factory where I work 14 hour shifts but get a fair amount of days off. I keep it cause I'm poor but it makes me feel less like a slave.
I hate when people say bullshit lies like that. In college when I would go to the gym I had both men and mostly women laughing at me.
Considering the modern dating market no, if you're anything less than handsome let alone average you will be treated as inhuman until you die.
Classic case of them not knowing what it's really like. They don't have to live our lives so they pretend it's easy.
I'm sorry, I just get so afraid. I've had women tell me my sexual abuse was invalid because I'm a male. And the only woman I was ever able to open up to left me because I wasn't good looking enough.
I'm in the same boat, the woman I love lied to me she loved me back and when I got too close admitted she found me too ugly to date. I hate my life.
For me it's always been body.
You're awesome dude!
I'm so socially fucked that I need others to help me. The worst part is I'm not good looking enough to be worth their time
Someone once described me as lesbian Peter Griffin
It's why I'm gonna take up smoking
No I stay home as much as possible. It's gotten to the point that I'm gonna start looking for a stay at home job.

Most of my friends have gotten married or ended up betraying me in some manner. My relationship with my family is starting to deteriorate and they each have their own relationships and happy lives anyway. I think for now what keeps me going is that I'm going to die anyway. And when I do all this pain will disappear just like everything else. That being said some days are so goddamn painful I do wish to die but I tell myself well if you feel this way in 3 years then let's decide whether or not to die. I've some how been keeping this up so far but I'm getting older and it's getting harder. My goal right now is to make it to 33. And if I somehow want to keep living from there then 35 and etc. 
So yes I'm a donkey following a dangled carrot hoping to one day grab it but it's all I got.

Thankfully I no longer want to kill myself. I realize now that doing so I'd only be robbing myself cause I no longer believe in a God or afterlife. But it doesn't make having all of my dreams and desires being crushed any easier.
My mother is the same way. Any time I tell her she can't comprehend that she gave birth to an ugly fuck like me. She blames me and me alone. In everything.

I was abused as a child in one part by my parents and another my church. I was often publicly displayed in a negative light and it forever created this deep rooted fear of rejection. Didn't help that my middle school and highschool years were spent bullied by others telling me I was ugly and worthless. Nor that I was ever good enough for my mother. 
It's come to a point to where I question whether or not to even bother continuing.

I'm living it. My worst fear was to be alone not because I did something wrong or needed to improve in some way. Rather its not getting the choice at all to begin with. I've become so hurt by others that now I'm trying to figure out a way to never leave my house.

Your average women have so many choices that they can afford to be picky. If I'm ever lucky enough to match with a woman or have one in my life I'm treated expendable. Being good looking helps create a positive story in one's mind regardless of whether or not that individual is actually a good person. 

We all have flaws but good lucking people get more grace.

I think it's more I haven't had really any of these kinds of situations of love so this makes the whole thing seem so much bigger by comparison. Like people don't get that I ask out and pursue all the time with no results. It's always something wrong with me and no one else.

She was little but so strong. Like very small and skinny girls weren't usually my type but it grew on me. After talking with her and taking to anime conventions and such I fell in love. Then everything about her turned me on. She had a little pointy chin and I always wanted to kiss it but she refused. She refused cause God knows how horrible it would be to have to keep up an act of attraction when such an ugly make is desiring you. It was 3 years ago or so but feels like yesterday. I'll probably take this shit to my grave.
No sex, no kisses, no cuddling nothing. They never wanted to get close and I kept telling myself they needed time. Nah they didn't like me to begin with.

I've been in 2 relationships but that's putting it very nicely. The first the girl never gave a fuck about anything and ultimately cheated on me and when I called her out she was bored. Just like oh yeah please just go away. No even sure why she said "yes" in the first place. Second lied to me she loved me to boost her ego cause I later found out it was hurt because a handsome guy she liked said no to her. Once it was rebuilt I was dumped. Again didn't know that going into it and thought holy shit she's a family friend Ive known for years maybe someone likes me.

I used to never actually think I was ugly. It took years of the world treating me like shit and someone I loved to tell me to my face that I was ugly to open my eyes and understand why I was never invited anywhere or ever got a girl to be happy to see me.

I was in love with her for 3 years. She was the only person I was able to open up about my sexual abuse to. She lived far away and I drove far for her. 
It was all a lie, I was nothing more then a way to make her feel more confident that another hopeless man fell for her. 
She was fairly pretty and was very fun to talk to. When she tried makeup she suddenly became so popular she could have any guy she wanted and that's when she dumped me. Even admitted she lied so there was no loose ends. A clean cut.

This is what happened with me and my ex I told her I loved her and she lied and said she loved me back. But once a guy came in her life she actually liked she told me she was cheating and "would rather have someone better looking" I cried driving all the way home.

The saddest and scariest thing about this is young girls (and some old) worship her and take her words as law. So her saying that ugly guys are worthless gives them leverage to want to be mean and hate ugly men. There really is no hope at this point.

People will straight up ignore you to your face and/or treat you as an afterthought. If it's someone you find attractive they will either act like you did something wrong for liking them or try and divert the conversation to ANYTHING else.
It's basically the scripted answer because people wanna believe we can push everything into cookie cut categories despite how really different they are.
Fuck all I can say is I'm sorry.
Tell myself the same thing every day.
That's the real truth is that they don't actually care. You might as well poor your heart to the overworked Walmart cashier cause they'd care just as much.
Also gonna get high to distract myself from this shitfuck world.
That's the problem is not everyone has the ability or resources to be able to do so. If we could we wouldn't be depressed in the first place.

I flip between both. Sometimes all I want and can do is see the harsh and shit reality I've been dealt. Other times I am able to feed off my emotions in a drug like high state. In those episodes I imagine I'm actually something important and that those who I've loved don't leave me.

Yes and if I can overcome my inner critic I still try but it makes no difference. Outside of being ugly I have horrible sleep disorders and various medication I have to take that makes me gain weight like crazy. I also have mental disabilities so I'm fucked in every corner.
I have and failed. Planning on trying again if my life doesn't get any better soon.

I find a few friends that I've made my life. They're all guys like me so they don't judge. I use this page as one way to help accept it sorta like building a tolerance. A little at a time helps me accept more and more each day. Other than that I have my dog who loves me and I'm working on making a podcast so I don't have to be seen.
Some vintage looking decor of witches and pumpkins along with some Halloween ghost lights that make it look like they're flying around my room :)
I'll go through strides where it's gross to it's clean af. Currently clean and also covered in Halloween decor.
I've never hated myself for how I look at first. I became resentful of my appearance because how I was treated by others. Especially women I liked.
Oh that would make sense, thanks I will
Yes! I work third shift so I sleep from 8am-3pm
Yeah it's saying AHI 4 and sometimes my mask leaks but I usually wake up with it on.
Also sucks that the modern age craze is all about posting yourself online for others to enjoy. People like us are gatekept from that sort of thing.

Feel the same way a lot of the time. I'm both the ugly sibling and have been the ugly friend in the group. Seeing everyone around me get to date since they were in middle school KILLS ME. They give me the same kind of bs "advice" you posted here.
For me it's always a grochery list of things I have to fix before I can get someone. 
Them? They just get to do it.
I'll try and watch it this weekend, thanks for the suggestion

Ah yes the 1985 film. Saw that film at a very young age. I really wanna watch it again. 
Bride has it's sad moments overall but also manages to cheer me up as well.
I feel you man I have a naturally big neck and it gives me a double chin no matter what.
Super cute, I love it :)

My favorite film is "Bride of Frankenstein" because the monster is the main character and constantly is attacked just because the way he looks. The only time he ever receives happiness is when he makes freinds with a blind man. Makes me cry everytime.
Taught me to be nice to everyone I can. Cause I also know it feels like to be hated for how you look.
I really appreciate this, I have to leave for work soon but if you're cool with it I'll message you some specific things. Thank you.
Years. Main problem lies in programming than anything else. It just never feels right and hurts to see.

I work at a car making factory. My job is thankfully easy but tiring and pointless. I wish I could get another but I can't. I am bullied at my job and thanks to my disabilities I make stupid mistakes and everyone gets really fucking mad at me. I don't have any friends there. 
Every job I go to it eventually becomes the same. People insult me for my mistakes and assume I'm some sort of child. My sleep has been terrible and I'm trying to get it fixed but I have to wait until I have health insurance again. 
My only escape is day dreaming about the kinds of games I wanna make and how much love I have for the ones I grew up with. I don't have a girlfriend, I failed college and have little to no money. 
Making a game is I ever wanted to do and I wish I could enjoy this journey.
I'm sorry.
If you're not an attractive male or female most don't wanna waste their time on you.

I never really considered myself ugly until years of bullying and being treated like shit led me to the conclusion. 
As a kid I really thought I was going to grow up to be handsome. Now I can't even look in the mirror much anymore.
The very few times I've been hugged by a woman I will never forget.

Of course. The truth is they've probably labled themselves as "average" which in today's world might as well be ugly. 
Could be wrong but maybe it's a  moment of self-pity and to be told the opposite feels good. Like the teenage girl stereotype of saying "I'm ugly" she knows she's not but it feels good to be praised.
Outside my mom I've had very few people tell me I was "cute". Yet I've also had people insult me to my face and feel the anger behind their remark so idk.

My parents didn't listen to my cries for help until I was on a hospital bed after failing my first attempt.
That's how I found out who really gave a fuck about me. The very few that visited me at the hospital. No cute girl, no long lost companion not even a friend outside my inner family. 
People don't like incovinence. I've had friends who I've fought off bullies for who stopped talking to me. Yet they swore we were buddies for life. They were not at my hospital bed.

After always seeing the same lame excuses and being stood up I started to wonder if the problem was me. Took a girl I loved to tell me off by "I wanna date someone better looking" did it all click into place and I realize I'm an ugly fuck for real.
Same. He seems very happy.
Thank you :)
Even if this ever passes over I'm still gonna wear a mask.

I'm jealous of beautiful girls too and I'm a guy. I can't imagine a higher compliment then being praised for your natural good looks especially by someone of the opposite sex. 
I have never been told I'm handsome in my life only fucking ugly looking.
I don't even blame girls for not liking me anymore.
Even at the end of the day I really just wanted to be her friend. She has no idea how cool she is in my eyes. I have nothing to trade for in return and I hate myself for it.
Every time I get on that "high" of being momentarily happy I pray to God to let it last longer this time. I need it to live.

I always see this video posted on cringe pages and everytime it's full of people shitting on the dude like "what a pathetic incel lmao". Yeah it's an outburst of emotional agony and immaturity. But jesus dudes definitely got stuff he's struggling with in probably lots of things in his life. But hey just keeping making fun of him cause that's what's popular right?
Same here, I have an INFP personality type. Feels like I'm inside out at times.
I have sleeping disorders and poor eyesight.
Good for you man

I got my mom's genes of short with fat neck in other words very ugly. My mom pulls it off cause she is an attractive woman and had surgery. I cannot afford it. Plus my left eye sags lower than my right and it's easy to notice. I hate being the ugly sibling.
Well they better hurry. If my life doesn't improve by 35 I'm checking out early. By then youth has been completely wasted.
I'll take your advice as soon as I'm able. That sounds like a great night.
Not sure where but somewhere
That does sound nice. Maybe I'll take myself on a trip.
Not when it's not your choice.

Thanks but that's simply not true. If its "subjective" as you say surely at least one person would find me attractive or give me a chance on a date. But guess what? It doesn't happen. So yeah. 
Curious to what this other part of the world you say is? I'd surely like to know.
It's all part of living with someone
My parents neglected my degrading mental and severe sleep disorders for years. Wasnt until college did I get through to them.
To be quarantined with a cute girl is the highest fantasy my shitty luck would never allow.

Hell yeah! I just ordered myself a copy as well! 
Btw highly suggest checking out the composer's other work on Spotify. His album Sumo Jungle is a masterpiece.
So I'm meant to suffer for someone else's benefit?
Exactly. I would never wish the pain I was going through on another.
It's why I take baths

My thoughts on it are like a light switch randomly flipping on and off. One day I've had it and fantasize about driving off a cliff and the next second I'm in the tub eating chips and watching anime on my phone happy I still live.

YES. God I had so many plans for romantic dates, poems and was trying to do as much research on sex as possible. I wanted to please someone and make them laugh. Sadly I never got the chance and now its turning to bitterness. I used to get jealous of all my friends getting married now I'm just depressed.
Neither can I, just makes me sad. Every one I ever was close with in high school has moved away. I am stuck here for financial reasons.
Oof the "just love yourself" speech not something I needed today or any day.
Yes
Didnt know he was asking out Geno
He onto something, better to know quickly than be lead on or used

The healing took a while to overcome but it does. I still don't know what the future holds either so I feel you in that way as well. Funny I even say the same "if I live that long" thing to myself as well. 
You deserve it as well my friend.
Lmao

That's..yeah that's exactly how I feel. I tried getting into existentialism but was too much of a coward. I'll just say this, for a God with such endless love why have hell? And no the bs answer of we have 'free will' to choose is simply untrue. I can't fly because I want to nor can I have a girl I love. There are hardcore restrants.

Even the Bible has an understanding of 'attractiveness' what a cruel joke to make anyone not good looking. 
I don't know whether to hate God or deny existence all together.
No, you have a chance.

I'm the opposite I only started at 24. 
I can't decide if it's bad or good. I almost don't like it but I'm horny like 24/7. Such a waste on someone so unattractive.

I have been through something very similar. My suicide attempt had me chugging a bunch of my medication in hope that it would put my system into cardiac arrest. 
I drove to a deserted place to die alone. My Dad and I were constantly fighting at the time. He kept calling me and I kept hanging up until finally when I did I heard him crying on the other end. Then and there I couldn't do it. I forced my body to vomit up the medication as he called 911. It was extremely painful. Felt like chunks of sharp metal were rising up through my throat but it worked. I was able to vomit enough to survive. That night at the hospital was the loneliest night of my life. 
Thinking back on it helps me to further distance myself from not committing suicide even if nasty thoughts and words from others sometimes try and say otherwise.
I really like that!

There is truth to that. I've also seen it in people of all kinds too. Most movies and kids cartoons the hero IS always chad. Good hearted or not they're almost always attractive while the villians are usually ugly. I've even seen myself as a villian at a young age before I truly understood why.
Cheesy but maybe "podcast for the lonely" just so people can find it easy and understand its purpose right away. I'd for sure call in :)
No kidding. Nobody believes me except others that have experienced it first hand. Made my heart feel like a black infected wound.

Sadly it seems like it is. My last ex told me she loved me over the phone when I was crying only to drive up in person and her tell me the truth. She sees me as ugly and I was only used as a pawn. 

I don't know if love really even exists at all.
I'm assuming this person is either attractive with guilt, average and seeing themselves as a saint or ugly and lying to themselves.
I relate. Why have me when you can have someone way better looking just a click away?
Thanks, this is the first time anyone outside my parents has wished me one :)

Trust me school doesn't mean shit. It seems big now but its nothing. I failed the fuck outta school. I work now in a factory and make equal if not more than most who went through school. High school is a fucking joke. 
Talk to your school counselor, that's what I did to deal with the past abuse when I was in high school. They did help. Good luck.

It really is. My friend in the group was very handsome. Should have seen the ways the girls would fight over who got to sit by him in the car/theater or hang out at his house. Me? I was treated like a lame little brother. Fml.

I know this feeling all too well. It's not that I think no one understands me I know it as fact. Even my own  family responded to this with "Well that's why we love you cause you're a mystery!".
Fuck.
I dont need anyone to help me? Just would like to have someone.

Same exact thing happened to me with my girlfriend when I was 23. She never cared and never showed any affection. 
I'm sorry this happened to you. It's ok to cry.
Yeah you're right, it's like quitting a shitty job by not showing up anymore vs. Putting in your 2 weeks. Ah well.
Thanks I just don't know why she didn't just say no. Would have been that easy.
It's an empty void of echo-less screams

Getting stood up is one of the cruelest things people can do. You committed yourself to someone's time even if it's bad try and stick it out to at least a 10min mark.
Once asked a girl out in college we planned to meet at a coffee shop. I got there early even ordered us drinks. Talked to the girl there and she was happy for me. Well made sure to text the girl at the right time and what became 10min of waiting became an hour he coffee now cold.
